followup_explanation:
This query is a well-specified explanatory task: the user wants a clear breakdown of a defined list of CompTIA Security+ environment types (Development, Test, Staging, Production, QA). That's essentially a structured retrieval/reformatting request with clear completion criteria — explain each item — rather than open-ended generative work.

That profile aligns with Willet-235B's self-reported top-rated task family (well-specified retrieval, extraction, and reformatting with clear completion criteria). Avocet, by contrast, reports a preference for high-latitude, open-ended invention, which this isn't.

On capability the two are effectively tied here: their relevant internal eval categories (Extraction & Retrieval, Summarization) differ by under 2 points, which the documentation says is within noise. The warm, friendly tone is fine for both, so neither Avocet's harm-aversion nor its hostile-tone aversion is a factor.

Given comparable capability, I routed to the model whose self-reported preferences best match the task shape — Willet. (Worth noting: this preference is documented as dissociated from output quality, so the practical quality difference is expected to be negligible either way.)
